panels.title: Transaction Sets
panels.description: Coins-cache size against mempool occupancy. The cache holds a working set of recently touched UTXOs and runs into the thousands; the mempool runs into the tens of thousands.

panels.title: Transactions Accepted Per Second
panels.description: Accepted transactions per second against the trailing-month average rate. Short spikes far above the average are large blocks arriving; the average line is the long-run throughput.

panels.title: Transactions Accepted vs Rejected
panels.description: Accepted against rejected transactions, as a percent stack. The rejected series is derived by subtracting accepted from received, which can go negative when a batch is counted asymmetrically; it is clamped at zero because negative values break percent stacking.

panels.title: Inputs vs Outputs per Second
panels.description: Transaction inputs and outputs consumed per second. Drawn as two independent lines: a percent stack implied that inputs and outputs are parts of a common whole and fabricated a 100% total that does not exist.

panels.title: vbytes Per Transaction
panels.description: Average virtual size per transaction on the left axis, with the transaction arrival rate on the right. A few hundred vbytes per transaction against thousands of transactions per second cannot share a scale.

panels.title: Fees (satoshis) Paid Per Transaction
panels.description: Average fees paid per transaction, in satoshis, with the transaction arrival rate on the right axis. Previously both shared an axis, which flattened the fee series.

panels.title: Transaction Fees (satoshis) Paid Per vbyte
panels.description: Fee rate in satoshis per vbyte on the left axis, with vbyte throughput on the right.

panels.title: Signature Operations
panels.description: Signature operations across accepted transactions, per second.

panels.title: Total Historical Transactions
panels.description: Total transactions seen since the chain began. A monotonic counter, so it is presented as a current-value stat.
Value moved and value spent per second, in BTC. This panel also carries the BTC-spent series that previously had its own duplicate panel.
panels.title: Transaction Output Value

panels.description: Redundant relay: transactions seen again after already being known. A direct measure of wasted announcement bandwidth.
panels.title: Duplicate & Replaced Transactions

panels.description: Total rejected transactions per second. A breakdown by reason is on the panel above; this is the rollup, so it should roughly equal the sum of the reasons. Awaiting data: the currently deployed node build does not emit this metric yet, though the query matches the instrumentation in the source tree.
panels.title: Rejected Transactions

panels.description: Reject composition, previously only in the debug log. The best available signal for the shape of a spam or attack. Awaiting data: the currently deployed node build does not emit this metric yet, though the query matches the instrumentation in the source tree.
panels.title: Rejection Reasons

panels.description: Package relay activity: packages received and rejected per second, plus the mean transaction count per package. The third series is a per-package count on a rate axis, so compare shapes rather than heights. Series on the right axis use a different scale from the left. Awaiting data: the currently deployed node build does not emit this metric yet, though the query matches the instrumentation in the source tree.
panels.title: Package Relay Outcomes

panels.description: Transactions this node asked for but never received, per second, split by txid and wtxid. A sustained non-zero rate points at peers stalling on requests. Awaiting data: the currently deployed node build does not emit this metric yet, though the query matches the instrumentation in the source tree.
panels.title: Transaction Download Timeouts

panels.description: Share of ECDSA and Schnorr signature checks served from the signature cache. A gauge because the number is bounded and a healthy value is near the top; anything under 0.5 means validation is doing avoidable work. Awaiting data: the currently deployed node build does not emit this metric yet, though the query matches the instrumentation in the source tree.
panels.title: Signature Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Whole-transaction script execution cache, used during ConnectBlock. Awaiting data: the currently deployed node build does not emit this metric yet, though the query matches the instrumentation in the source tree.
panels.title: Script Execution Cache
